verses.text: Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, emanh t'a spat jun winh tz'akum lu'um. Hata' ol wal jun lolonel t'ayach, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in em b'i'an, wan stz'akwi winh t'a jun tz'aklab' tzek' sururok.
Ayik wan stz'akan jun lum chen winh, haxo ix aji ix ixtaxb'at lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Yuj chi' hanheja' yet' lum slumal chi' ix sb'o junxo lu'um winh icha snib'ej.
T'a jun rato chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ha in wal Jehová in swal t'ayex israel ex tik: ¿Tom max yal ex wutan icha syutej lum lum winh tz'akum tik stz'akani? Ha ex tik, lajan heyaj t'a yol in k'ab' icha yaj lum lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh tz'akum tik.
K'inalok a in tik tzin na' in juanb'ati, ma in satanel junok chonhab', ma junok makb'en,
palta tato a jun chonhab' chi' sna sb'a sk'o'ol, syik'anel sb'a t'a skal chukal, hanhejtona' in tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak'b'at jun yahelal chi' t'a yib'anh.
K'inalok tzin na' in b'o'ank'e junok chonhab' yet' wak'an k'ib'ok,
palta tato anhej chukal sk'ulej, max sk'anab'ajej pax tas swala', tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak' in wach'k'olal nab'il wuj wak'an t'ay.

Al t'a heb' kajan t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén to a in swal juntzanh lolonel tik: Wan in na'an tas ol ex wutej, tas ol aj wak'anoch eyahelal, yuj chi' aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al, k'ulejek wach'il, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ol yalan heb' t'ayach icha tik: Manh ixtej a b'a onh a kachani. Ha onh tik ol ko k'ulejnhej chukal, icha tas skot t'a ko pensar ko k'ulani, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: k'anb'ejek ek' t'a junjun nación, tato ay b'aj ix ab'chaj sk'ulaj icha tas sk'ulej heb' etisraelal tik. Ha heb' tik yelxo wal te chuk tas sk'ulej heb'.
¿Tok ay junok tiempo'al manh ayokem k'e'en sakb'akom t'a jolomtak witz t'a yol yik Líbano? ¿Ay am b'aj stup ha ha' te si'ik skot t'a jolomtak witz chi'?

Palta a ex in chonhab' ex tik, manh junnhejok b'aj ayexkani, kotak skal tze k'exan he pensar. Tzin eyaktankani, haxo t'a tas manh diosok tze nhus incienso. Ex satb'at t'a jun b'e aytaxon t'a peka'. Haxo t'a b'e yik chukal b'aj tzex b'ati.
Yuj he chukal chi' ol kan tzinan he chonhab' tik. Ol te b'uchjoknhej. Masanil heb' ol ek' t'a tik, ol laj syum sat heb' ex stzetzani, yujto satub'tak ol aj yilji.

Icha tz'aj saklemb'at tastak yuj ik' skot b'aj sjawi k'u, icha chi' ol aj ex wak'an saklemb'at yuj heb' eyajk'o'ol. Ol in b'at mikan t'ayex ayik ol ja sk'uhal sjawi he yahelal chi'. Manhxo ol in b'at k'elan t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ko na'ek tas skutej winhaj Jeremías tik yuj tas syal winh t'a kib'anh. Tokwal ol lajwokel heb' sacerdote tzonh k'ayb'ani, ma heb' aj pensar tz'ak'an ko razón, ma heb' schekab' Dios tz'alan slolonel Dios chi' t'ayonh. Yuj chi' ko na'ekk'e esal lolonel t'a spatik winh, yik smiljicham winh. Manh ol ko k'anab'ajejlaj tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, tzab'an wal tas syal heb' ayoch ajk'olal tik t'ayin.

¿Tom yet' chukal tz'aj spaktzitaj wach'k'olal? Ha heb' chi' toxo ix sna heb' tas ol yutej heb' in smilanchamok. Nakoti to ix in k'och t'a ichanh in tewi t'ayach yuj swach'ilok heb', yik max ak'kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb'.

Haxo tikne'ik jun, ak' cham yuninal heb' yuj wejel yet' yuj owal. Kanokab' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' junixtakil, manhxa'okab' junok yune' heb' ix skani. Miljokab'cham heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo heb' winh yune' heb' ix kelemtakxo, chamokab' heb' t'a owal.
Ak'kot junok nhilanh soldado elk'um t'a skal heb'. Ab'chajokab' yel yaw heb' yuj syahelal, yujto ichato sjoy olan heb' b'aj ol in mukchajok, say modo heb' tas tz'aj in telwi t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak masanil tastak smol alej heb' t'a wib'anh yik tzin smilancham heb' yalani. Manh ak' niwank'olal heb', mokab' b'at smul heb' chi' satk'olal u'uj. Satokab'el heb' t'a ichanh, ak'och syahelal heb' yuj yowal a k'o'ol.
